description: This header defines constants, macros, and data structures related to HTTP protocol elements, such as methods, status codes, headers, request/response info, and authentication. It serves as a foundational set of definitions for HTTP communication in a broader C/C++ project.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_WARNING
classes.description: Represents HTTP Warning header field including warning code, text, hostname, and port.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_WWW_AUTHENTICATE
classes.description: Represents WWW-Authenticate header with challenge count and challenge array.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_PROXY_CONNECTION
classes.description: Represents Proxy-Connection header with token count and token array.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_COOKIE
classes.description: Represents Cookie header with cookie count and array of cookie contents.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_SET_COOKIE
classes.description: Represents Set-Cookie header with cookie count and array of cookie contents.

classes.name: HTTP_HFO_COOKIE2
classes.description: Represents Cookie2 header as per RFC 2965.
